name: DUMBBELL PULLOVER
introduce:
Lie on a bench with your head slightly hanging off the edge of the bench. 

Extend your arms over your chest and hold a dumbbell with your hands interlocked. 

Keep your elbows tight, lower the dumbbell backward as low as you can, then slowly return. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell that you feel comfortable with.
Please tighten your elbows and keep them as straight as possible.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
You should feel your chest working.
